# Open choices: api-design

`aidd-team:api-design` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cli-framework` | Which library parses the arguments of a command-line tool and writes its help? | The language's own parser for a tool with a few flags, and the ecosystem's common framework once it has subcommands, so one definition gives the parsing, the help, and the shell completions. | argparse, Click, Typer, Commander, Cobra, clap |
